en: The Philippines actually consists of 7,641 islands, not the previously taught number of 7,107.
The Pasig River flows westward from Laguna de Bay into Manila Bay, not the other way around.
The Philippine Sea is located on the eastern side of the archipelago, not on the western side.
Laguna de Bay is the largest lake by surface area, but Lake Mainit is actually much deeper.
Mount Apo is the highest mountain in the Philippines, whereas Mount Pulag is only the highest in Luzon.
Mayon Volcano is located in the Bicol Region, not in the northern Cordillera mountain range.
Palawan is part of the Luzon group of islands, not geographically located in the Visayas.
The Banaue Rice Terraces are man-made agricultural structures, not a natural geological mountain formation.
Taal is a complex volcano with a crater lake on an island, not a simple single peak.
The Philippines experiences only wet and dry seasons, not four distinct seasons, due to its tropical location.
The Philippine Trench is the deepest in the Philippine Sea, but the Mariana Trench is deeper globally.
The Tubbataha Reefs are located in the Sulu Sea, not in the eastern Pacific Ocean.
